title: computeRatio bench-metric: mcp_tool lines counted in gross AND subtracted for net — locality confirmed on v5/v7 data
summary: MEASURED GOTCHA (observed on real v5/v7 bench data): computeRatio must count source=="mcp_tool" usage lines in BOTH gross AND net (they are assistant turns). net = gross − mcp_overhead where mcp_overhead = sum of (input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) for source=mcp_tool lines only. Skipping mcp_tool lines from gross produces a ratio ~8× too low (measured: v5 gross ratio 8.1354 vs wrong impl 1.03). The cache_read_input_tokens on MCP lines can be only ~1800–2000 tokens but dominates gross vs net difference. Missing sub-fields (missing cache_read_input_tokens) must default to 0 — observed in real transcripts where early turns lack the field. Round each ratio to 4 decimal places.
